query: select statement_timestamp() as checked_at, d.recipient_role, (p.user_id is not null) as has_matching_role_preferences, coalesce(p.push_enabled,false) as matching_role_push_enabled, count(*)::int as pending_deliveries, count(*) filter (where d.expires_at is null)::int as no_expiry, count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from public.notification_push_devices dev where dev.user_id=d.recipient_user_id and dev.active))::int as with_active_device from public.notification_deliveries d left join public.notification_preferences p on p.user_id=d.recipient_user_id and p.role_context=d.recipient_role where d.channel='PUSH' and d.state='CREATED' and d.push_started_at is null group by d.recipient_role,(p.user_id is not null),coalesce(p.push_enabled,false);
correction: Earlier account-wide preference aggregation did not join role_context to recipient_role. A push-enabled preference in another role does not authorize these REQUESTER deliveries. The earlier statement that requester push preference was enabled is superseded for this queue.
